general_information.Description: This course will introduce the student to the essential best practices in database security strategies. The student will be provided with the tools, techniques and industry accepted methodologies so that upon completion of the course the student will be able to describe key concepts database security and how to apply those concepts to securing database management systems within their orgaization.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Vmware Workstation - Mysql server, SQL server, Oracle Server

description: This course will introduce the student to the essential best practices in database security strategies. The student will be provided with the tools, techniques and industry accepted methodologies so that upon completion of the course the student will be able to describe key concepts database security and how to apply those concepts to securing database management systems within their orgaization.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the role of database and information systems security for enterprise and organization
Understand Security Architecture and plan defines steps to reinstate a network after a disaster occurs
Understand the steps of administrator must take into account prior to installation of a database Secure the installation and configuration of various database management systems
Understand the different database management system models and applications and describe the architecture of Oracle, MySQL, and Microsoft SQL Server
Understanding Secure the installation and configuration of MySQL server
Understanding Secure the installation and configuration of Microsoft SQL server
Understanding Secure the installation and configuration of Oracle
Understanding Password, Profiles, Privileges, and Roles with SQL Server, MySQL, and Oracle
Experience the case studies of hacking SQL injection
Understand common SQL statements and SQL constructs used to exploit weaknesses
Perform SQL injection exploitation and identify defensive strategies against these exploits
Perform the auditing activities that are specific to database security auditing
Understand the methodology used to perform a security test
